method: Native in-app browser interaction plus Chromium mouse/keyboard stress sequences; rendered screenshots inspected individually, alongside geometry and state assertions.

fixes.problem: Short picker content starts above the reachable scroll origin
Camera help is cropped when a desktop sidebar narrows the viewer
Fitted atoms are cropped after sidebar/window resizing
Existing picker close button scrolls away

inspectedCheckpoints.observation: 501-atom scene, cell preview and boundary bonds are rendered; projected rows and the isolated added atom remain visible.
Undo after deletion restores a populated oblique atom/bond scene with the frame visible.

After a boundary move and shrinking the oblique a face, the frame contains projected atom centers. Sphere surfaces may straddle faces. The element legend was caught during its existing fade-in; this image alone does not validate that legend.
Panel collapse plus Escape leaves the frame, atoms and preserved measurement rendered; cancellation status states geometry restoration.
Accepting a replacement during an atom move shows the incoming two-atom fixture and bond, without the previous frame or drag plane.
Narrow portrait viewer remains populated after playback/rebuild/selection undo; timeline play icon and frame counter are visible.
Dense playback remains populated in the narrow viewer; complete projected cell and pause icon are visible.
After 16 mixed boundary-edit cycles, undo restores four atom spheres and the frame. Legend is captured partway through its existing fade-in.
Repeated atom move followed by frame resize retains four atom spheres, expected projected bonds and visible frame.

nativeChecks: Loaded graphene, selected atoms, switched modes, toggled labels and periodic images, zoomed and reset.
Loaded H2O trajectory, hid cell, reset and expanded sidebar to its maximum; all three atoms remained visible after the framing fix.
Opened examples and scrolled to the bottom before and after the close-button fix; existing close button stays anchored after the fix.
Started trajectory playback, observed pause icon and advancing frame count, paused and scrubbed to final frame; play icon and 24/24 remained visible.

fullBrowserSuite.configuration: Repository browser configuration, local testDir and output paths, existing 4173 server reused; list reporter.

limits: Representative combinations and screenshots, not every possible input sequence.
Browser regression suite uses Chromium and pinned local Three.js dependencies; native checks use the Codex in-app browser. Other GPU/browser combinations are unverified.
Small atoms/labels in a cell fitted around a large vacuum region are not treated as a defect without a separate reproduction.
Post-resize evidence waits two animation frames; a cleared buffer captured before the queued render was replaced, not counted as a solved rendering bug.

completionAudit.directVisualInspection: Native browser screenshots plus nine individually inspected full-suite checkpoints retained here; before/after fixes retained in sibling directories.
completionAudit.crossFunctionCoverage: Boundary moves, cell resizing, selection/measurement, undo/redo, display/periodic toggles, camera operations, sidebar/window resizing and file/trajectory transitions exercised in the full suite and native/sweep sequences.
completionAudit.reproducibleFindings: Four visual bugs found, fixed, reproduced before and verified after. No additional reproducible defect in the inspected final checkpoints.
completionAudit.preservation: Only the isolated temporary native tab was operated on; original collapsed sidebar preference restored and temporary tab closed. No user documents reloaded or edited; no push or added buttons.
completionAudit.remainingRequiredWork: None for this representative visual stress-test campaign. Unverified breadth is explicitly listed in limits.
